statusAwaitingUpdateDecision: A new client version is available
statusUpToDate: The client is up to date
statusUnknownClient: Unable to determine the client status
bodyUpdating: Keep this window open while the updater processes managed files.
bodyReady: The update is complete. You can continue to launch the client.
bodyUnknownClient: Console has no client version list. The current client status is unknown.
cacheVerificationDescription: Verifying the cached ZIP byte by byte. Extraction starts after it passes.
downloadResumed: Resuming from a local partial file. The full ZIP will be verified after completion.
downloadFresh: Downloading the full update package from the current source. The ZIP will be verified after completion.
managedConflictDescription: The managed files below differ from local content. Choose which file version to keep for each conflict.
hydrolineLoggedIn: Your Hydroline account is signed in. Protected download sources are available.
manualLaunchUnavailable: Minecraft cannot be launched from a manually opened updater.
openClientDetailsFailed: Unable to open the client details window: {error}
noData: No data is available yet. Console data may still be syncing.
